_comment: The year's actual benefit payment dates, fetched live from canada.ca's Benefits payment dates page. The cash-flow forecast reads these; a forecast running on a stale schedule is silently wrong, so scripts/check-benefit-dates.js fails the build once reviewBy passes — the 2027 schedule publishes in December and must be fetched before the year turns. The Canada Carbon Rebate is deliberately absent: the program closed (the page lists 2025 dates only).

cgeb.label: Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit
cgeb.note: Renamed from the GST/HST credit in July 2026. The January 5 and April 2 payments were issued under the old name and belong to the closed series; the quarterly cadence continues under this one.

oas_gis.label: Old Age Security and Guaranteed Income Supplement
